title: triticum repens subsp. biflorum
intro: Triticum repens subsp. biflorum, commonly known as wild wheat or annual wild rye, is a plant species within the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to provide relief from various health issues, offering health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Triticum repens subsp. biflorum include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
